title: Bullying and Social Health
learningOutcomes: Understand the key ideas behind bullying and social health and why this topic matters for child development.
Learn practical skills and strategies that help apply bullying and social health in everyday parenting situations.
Build confidence using bullying and social health to support connection, safety, and positive family routines.

modules.title: Understanding the Topic
modules.description: Learn what bullying and social health means and why it matters for child development.

modules.title: Core Skills and Strategies
modules.description: Explore practical skills and strategies for applying bullying and social health in everyday parenting.

modules.title: Real-Life Application
modules.description: See how bullying and social health works in real situations with examples and simple scripts.

modules.title: Reflection and Integration
modules.description: Reflect on your learning and plan how to use bullying and social health in daily family life.

caseworkerSummary: This topic helps parents build practical skills related to bullying and social health. It supports safer, more consistent caregiving by improving understanding, strengthening emotional connection, and reducing stress in daily routines. This topic is suitable for parents who need guidance in applying positive parenting strategies and may benefit families working toward stability, reunification, or improved home safety.
